h: The Departing Shabbos Leaves an Inheritance of Holy Longing

p: "And grant us as a heritage, Hashem our God,
in love and favor, Your holy Shabbos."
that is, that it remain so forever.
For we find in the Gemara (Shabbos 118a)
the expression "one who delights the Shabbos,"
and they did not say "one who delights himself on Shabbos";
that is, he delights the day of Shabbos,
and that is the additional soul,
that is, he intends it for the sake of Heaven,
and from this there is vitality for the additional soul.
and in the holy Zohar (Vayakhel, daf 204)
the matter of the additional soul is alluded to
and it would have been more fitting to allude to it
there was a resting of holiness,
according to what the Rokeach wrote
at the beginning of his book:
"There is no strength like piety at its beginning";
and that is for the reason
that at first Hashem Yisbarach bestows
on the person who turns himself to Hashem Yisbarach
(for His light, may He be blessed,
so that he will afterward yearn for it,
to attain it as he tasted its taste.
וְעַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁאָמַר רַבֵּינוּ הַקָּדוֹשׁ
And according to what our holy Rebbe,
זֵכֶר צַדִּיק וְקָדוֹשׁ לִבְרָכָה לְחַיֵּי הָעוֹלָם הַבָּא
may the memory of the righteous and holy be for a blessing in the life of the World to Come, said
זֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ וַיִּקְרָא דַּף כב, ב)
that is, Hashem Yisbarach showed them
כְּדֵי שֶׁעַל יְדֵי הַחֵשֶׁק אַחַר כָּךְ
so that through the yearning afterward
the revelation of the Shechinah at the time of Matan Torah.
there remains an impression of holiness at its departure,
and the great yearning to attain it
as they tasted on holy Shabbos.
that an impression of holiness remains
for the three days after Shabbos,
And therefore the additional soul is alluded to
for then is the main sensing,
and from this one merits eternal life,
as an inheritance that has no interruption

A Withheld Light Awakens Enduring Longing

paragraphs.text: Source: Shemos 31:17 — “ביני ובין בני ישראל אות הוא לעלם כי ששת ימים עשה יהוה את השמים ואת הארץ וביום השביעי שבת וינפש” — “it shall be a sign for all time between Me and the people of Israel. For in six days יהוה made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day [God] ceased from work and was refreshed.”
